lesson.uz:
Chiziqli qidiruv elementlarni ketma-ket tekshiradi. Topilmasa -1, topilsa shartda so‘ralgan indeks yoki sonni qaytaring. Takrorlangan qiymatlar bo‘lishi mumkin.
Oddiy saralashda ichma-ich sikl bilan qiymatlarni solishtirib, vaqtinchalik o‘zgaruvchi yordamida almashtiring. O‘sish tartibi kichikdan kattaga. Indeks 0 dan boshlanadi. Saralash asl tartibni o‘zgartiradi.
lesson.en:
Linear search checks elements one by one. Return -1 when absent or the requested index/count when found. Values may repeat.
For simple sorting, compare values with nested loops and swap using a temporary variable. Ascending order means smallest first. Indexes start at 0. Sorting changes the original order.

statement.uz: Maktab do‘koni: n ta zaxirani massivga saqlang. So‘ng 2 ga teng birinchi zaxira indeksini (topilmasa -1) chiqaring. Indekslar 0 dan boshlanadi.
statement.en: School shop: Store n stock values in an array, then print the first index holding 2 (-1 if absent). Indexes start at 0.

inputFormat.uz: n (1..100), keyin n ta butun son (0..10000), har biri alohida qatorda.
inputFormat.en: n (1..100), then n integers (0..10000), one per line.

outputFormat.uz: So‘ralgan natijalarni berilgan tartibda, har birini alohida qatorda chiqaring. Qo‘shimcha matn chiqarmang.
outputFormat.en: Print the requested results in order, one per line, with no extra text.
